staged_evidence_note: The 14 target outcomes were already used in the preceding GSE146194 WitnessCell experiment, but no GEARS or CPA prediction on these targets had been generated or inspected when this six-way protocol was fixed. This is a model-blind named-AIVC confirmation, not a never-inspected biological cohort.
single_claim: On exactly the same strict-seen1 targets and information budget, endpoint Witness geometry can improve named AIVCs and can itself form a competitive combinatorial AIVC.

factorial_design.statistical_unit_note: The same 14 target pairs recur across fits. Model seeds and cells are not independent biological replicates.

information_contract.source_half_A_model_validation_outcomes: named checkpoint and Witness hyperparameter selection only
information_contract.destination_half_B_witness_calibration_o: closed-form Witness amplitude and model-specific fusion weight only

preprocessing.evaluation_gene_selection: largest mean absolute source-half-A double effect over the 12 model-train pairs; target double outcomes forbidden
preprocessing.model_gene_space: top 5000 source-training-only variable genes plus all 1000 evaluation genes and every perturbation target gene; exact implementation and gene order must be identical for GEARS and CPA

witnesscell.fusion: For each named model M, lambda_M=clip(<W_cal-M_cal,R_cal-M_cal>/<W_cal-M_cal,W_cal-M_cal>,0,1); final residual=(1-lambda_M)M+lambda_M W.

training_budget.rule: No target outcome may determine epochs. Reuse the existing CUDA/PyTorch/GEARS/CPA environments. Run one engineering smoke, then one full-data validation-only maturity trace per model; freeze maximum epochs and checkpoint policy before any final-target archive is scored.
training_budget.formal_checkpoint: validation-only; test outcomes never select checkpoints

decision_tree.augmentation_pass: A named model is Witness-improvable only if its paired augmentation comparison passes every frozen condition.
decision_tree.independent_aivc_pass: WitnessCell is stronger than the named-model set only if WitnessCell_vs_GEARS and WitnessCell_vs_CPA both pass; no test-selected best-model shortcut is allowed.
decision_tree.heterogeneous_result: If only one augmentation passes, report model-dependent complementarity rather than a universal wrapper.
decision_tree.stop: If WitnessCell does not beat either named model and neither augmentation passes, stop the external named-AIVC superiority claim.

claim_boundaries: All 14 final targets share the FDPS hub; pair inference is pathway-panel evidence, not hub-population inference.
This gate does not test seen0.
A 3x3 matrix contains 9 stochastic fits per named model, not 9 independent biological experiments.
Saturation and WitnessCell require no GPU fit and are common construction controls, not extra stochastic models.
